gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Hairline joins are gone from Tilt Neon, replaced by full-width stroke connections that make each letter look like bent tubing. gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs rises almost to cap height in its lowercase, with terminal tips pointing outward. But Tilt Neon above it traces a laser-etched line of constant width, so the display heading hums while the text stays quiet.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic has a pronounced x-height and wide openings on its small letters, which keeps the text easy on the eye. Tilt Neon, drawn like a ballpoint line, is the louder one.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Armenian, whose round letters open wide and whose c, s and z stand tall. Tilt Neon's joins keep their full width.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Avestan keeps the tips of its curves apart and lifts its x-height high. Noto Sans Avestan would carry a long page with a steady, unfussy ease, while Tilt Neon holds its line width through every turn up top.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Tilt Neon has no thin strokes to vanish in the glare, just a splayed c terminal and a large x-height. But Noto Sans Balinese does the quieter work, giving every curved glyph breathing space in a plain sans.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin give Tilt Neon its look, with a splayed c terminal on top. Noto Sans Bamum stays open in every small letter.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Tilt Neon never varies its stroke weight, so the heading reads like a single glowing tube. And Noto Sans Bassa Vah is the sans-serif that grounds it, with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-batak: Approachable describes Noto Sans Batak, with a towering x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. And Tilt Neon, whose stems and crossbars share one thickness, sits above it as a bold counterpart to that sans-serif text.
